verses.text: They have gone up to their temple and to Dibon, That is, to their high places, to weep. Over Nebo and over Medeba Moab howls; Upon all their heads is baldness; Every beard is shaved off.
In their streets they have girded themselves with sackcloth; On their roofs And in their open squares everyone will howl, Melting in tears.

verses.text: For the cry has gone about The border of Moab; Their howling goes as far as Eglaim, Even to Beer-elim their howling reaches.
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood, For I will bring upon Dimon additional things: Lions upon those in Moab who escape And upon the remnant of the land.
